subject: refactor(material/menu): switch tests away from fakeAsync (#32909)

hunk_reviews.rationale: Decline this private menu scheduler migration. Its complete122-case/8-hook original preserves all case identities and all nonboundary operations after explicitly enumerated timer/detection changes. Two outer error-observer bodies lose nested simulated ticks; two private host selectors are added and an overlap helper drops its500ms flush. These changes neither prove legacy opening/idempotence/error timing, focus, geometry nor teardown equivalence. Cyph actually imports and uses legacy menu/trigger/item markup, so this is not an absence or inherited-peer exclusion. Keep owned Material16 selectors/templates/styles, retained fixture setup and explicit error/lifecycle observations. No consumer or product port is justified by this private fixture preference; actual packed/native/browser/minimum gates remain required.
